children: Japanese stocks are higher in early trade as Jensen Huang's return as the Nvidia chief executive revives an artificial-intelligence trade. Chip and metals stocks are leading the gains. Kioxia Holdings is up 7.3%, SoftBank Group is 5.0% higher, and JX Advanced Metals is up 6.6%. The dollar is at 158.89 yen, compared with Y159.00 as of Monday 5 p.m. Eastern time. Investors are focusing on crude oil prices and bond yields. The Nikkei Stock Average is up 2.7% at 57961.62. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
